requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years and current ICE Coffee C COT observation
requirements.policy: CFTC public API; exact COFFEE C futures-only disaggregated contract

requirements.requirement: weekly current lawful JO and other listed coffee-vehicle notes/shares, AUM and observable flows
requirements.policy: issuer/sponsor primary data only; if lawful history is unavailable mark manual or unavailable, never infer flows from price

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥30 years of dated ONI history
requirements.policy: NOAA CPC observed ONI only; it cannot substitute for regional weather or a probabilistic outlook
reuse one Federal Reserve/FRED semantic series; no commodity-specific clone

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years of producer BRL/VND/COP against USD
requirements.policy: primary central-bank or lawful market history with exact FX bases and roles

requirements.requirement: current front-month ICE Coffee C quote
requirements.policy: reuse swarm pulse quote transport (`@KC.1`); label US¢/lb futures

requirements.requirement: point-in-time ICE Coffee C close history with source identity
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@KC.1`; continuous back-adjusted futures

requirements.requirement: current Coffee C settlements with ≥3 years of curve snapshots
requirements.policy: lawful ICE settlements with exact contracts; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years of unit/FX-aligned Arabica-Robusta spread history and a current observation
requirements.policy: lawful ICE prices; one substitution cluster after conversion to a common unit

requirements.requirement: current Coffee C physical basis by deliverable grade, origin and location
requirements.policy: lawful ICE/primary trade quotations with grade, defects, location, unit and contract month; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current ICE Coffee C delivery notices, pending grading and load-out pressure by location
requirements.policy: lawful ICE delivery/warehouse reports with contract and report date; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: daily current ICE certified stocks by grade/location and pending grading
requirements.policy: lawful ICE warehouse reports; preserve revisions and never infer off-exchange stocks

requirements.requirement: quarterly/semiannual; ≥10 years of production, consumption and stocks
requirements.policy: ICO/USDA primary balances with vintage and Arabica/Robusta split

requirements.requirement: monthly current Brazil/Vietnam/Colombia shipments by destination
requirements.policy: Cecafe/national customs/ICO primary data; announced sales cannot replace shipment

requirements.requirement: current plus ≥30 years of yield-weighted frost/drought/monsoon weather aligned to crop stage
requirements.policy: primary meteorological observations/forecasts with geography, run time and expiry

requirements.requirement: current area, yield, tree age and biennial-cycle output by major origin with dispersion
requirements.policy: CONAB/USDA/national primary crop releases; distinguish observed crop from forecast

requirements.requirement: current EUDR/compliance, port constraints and verified rerouting
requirements.policy: primary regulator/customs/port evidence with effective date and expiry

requirements.requirement: current marginal farm cash-cost and export-parity range
requirements.policy: primary farm budgets and lawful freight/FX; separate observed price, model range and market expectation
